role: production public signup/access and country/compliance policy
canonical_public_url: deployment-defined HTTPS URL; do not invent a placeholder domain in user-facing builds

enforcement_points: CDN/edge or reverse proxy before application routing
session renewal and high-risk privileged actions
country_signal: declared country as a secondary consistency signal only
public_access.bypass_claim: GeoIP/country blocking is a policy control, not a perfect proof of physical location; do not advertise it as impossible to bypass.
public_access.sanctions_and_export_controls: Country block does not replace sanctions-list, end-user/end-use, EAR/export-classification, or other jurisdiction-specific compliance screening.

blocked_response.behavior: deny signup, session creation, tenant provisioning, local-agent registration, and application execution
blocked_response.content: show a neutral access-unavailable notice and support/compliance contact path; do not expose internal policy/risk signals
